Plants of the World Online account: Heteromorpha arborescens (Spreng.) Cham. & Schltdl..

The native range of this species is Ethiopia to S. Africa, SW. Arabian Peninsula. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.
